title: Subscription change
idea: Subscription change: Current terms and proposed terms are aligned with effective date, proration and cancellation consequences.
audience: People who need to change plan within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: The change has financial or service-continuity effects.
avoidWhen: Prices and billing rules are unresolved but appear final.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its change plan priority and explicit commitment contract: Confirm server-calculated effective terms before committing a change.
navigation: Subscription change keeps the current change plan context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Current terms and proposed terms are aligned with effective date, proration and cancellation consequences.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to change plan; the change has financial or service-continuity effects.
composition.priority: Confirm server-calculated effective terms before committing a change.

imagery.role: Support the actual change plan context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Read current plan then proposed change then full confirmation without a crowded comparison grid.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the subscription change structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no change plan content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Confirm server-calculated effective terms before committing a change.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized change plan content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Confirm server-calculated effective terms before committing a change.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active change plan context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
